facts.F34: Layers and carriers. Domain: NoConnectionCause (choice type) with states NotSetUp, NoSecretsKey, Unreadable, NotConnected per ChannelKind; operation words(Viewer); observation ConnectionWords (words plus ordered fixes); no decision, effect, error or per-process state carrier is added. Application: the three doors (workspace page, route form GET, routes preview and save posts) read the instance snapshot through state.integrations.current() and the viewer from NavContext, and render ConnectionWords; the outcome is a rendered page, not a refusal type. Adapter: Askama templates workspace.html, route_form.html, project.html render fixes in order; GET /admin/instance/integrations is guarded by require_instance_admin, which answers the uniform not-found page otherwise. Infrastructure: unchanged; nothing is stored, queued or recovered by this change.
facts.F35: Liveness is not applicable: one synchronous render answers one request, the design adds no queue, retry, lease, replica handoff or progress obligation, and no promise names eventual progress. facts.F37: Claim-to-checker mapping. Every claim in this design is local, pure and finite, and each is covered by the checker that actually decides it. Totality and the exclusion of an unopenable or misordered offer: the repository's own checker, rustc, over the closed NoConnectionCause, SlackOffer and MatrixOffer enums, with words the only writer of fixes, so no other arm can add an href. The whole relation: exhaustive enumeration of all 112 (cause, connected, Viewer) rows in the module's finite table, which is complete rather than sampled. The link-to-guard agreement: the public oracle follows each offered link off the rendered page and observes its status, which is the real guarantor; a model of that agreement could only restate the assumption about require_instance_admin. No state-transition, temporal, fairness, concurrency or recovery claim exists, so no state model is selected: Quint, TLA+ and Agda would add a second encoding of the same finite table and no checking power. Observed on this host for the record, not as the reason: quint, agda and apalache-mc are absent and the java launcher is misconfigured (jenv points at an uninstalled 26 while Corretto 27 is installed); node and npm are present. The one gap no checker closes is a template writing an href literally instead of rendering fixes, recorded as a Bypass risk with its owner.
